name: balseraphs_warrior
description: a Balseraphs Warrior, a slim grinning jester-fighter: wild shaggy auburn hair, a black domino mask over the eyes and a wide grin, a green ruffled collar, a purple-and-gold harlequin diamond suit studded with little gold bells, a green sash at the waist, curled green-and-purple jester shoes with gold bells on the toes, a studded wooden club hung with gold bells and a green ribbon in his RIGHT hand, and a round purple-and-gold diamond-pattern shield with a wooden rim on his LEFT arm
hands: the bell club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the round shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the bell club is lifted beside the head with its studded head pointing up and back, the round shield held in front
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the bell club's studded head hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the round shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the bell club is level, its studded head pointing to the right, bells flying
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded bell club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the round shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the bell club carries on down until its studded head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, shaggy hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the bell club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the round shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut behind the black mask, grin gone, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the round shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the bell club dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the round shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the bell club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the bell club's studded head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the bell club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the curled jester shoes pointing up; the bell club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks, the bells jingle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed behind the black mask, the bell club and the round shield on the ground beside him
